$comment: dbfr (production): what runs in Docker and what the host is still allowed to run (decision 2026-10-09: Docker is THE service runtime, no host copy of a containerized service). `purge` is applied by scripts/tools/infra/host-purge.ts (idempotent).

containers.aphrody-gateway-1: nginx 80/443 of every public vhost (dragonballfr.com, aphrody.com, rosegriffon.fr); TLS from /etc/aphrody/shenron-tls
containers.aphrody-bun-prod-1: Bun fork probe 47660 (ghcr.io/aphrody-labs/bun), the only Bun probe outside k8s

packages.certbot python3-certbot python3-certbot-: renews /etc/letsencrypt (webroot /var/www/letsencrypt served by the gateway, dns-ovh); deploy hook shenron-container copies to /etc/aphrody/shenron-tls and reloads aphrody-gateway-1 with docker exec

units.aphrody-desktop-xvfb.service aphrody-des: virtual desktop and VNC on wg1 (host X11)
units.aphrody-mcp-http-dbfr.service: aphrody-mcp http 8793 for the wg clients: the aphrody:runtime image lacks the toolbox tools (13 of 341: RAG, jobs, OCR, transcribe, home, remote_vnc, site_catalog), checked 2026-10-09
units.shenron-compute.service: aphrody-mcp http 8789 for shenron-bot (same toolbox gap)
units.aphrody-discord-dev.service: bot.aphrody.com 4010 (Bun); deployed as a unit by atomic-deploy-aphrody-discord.sh
units.aphrody-downloads.service: aphrody.com and downloads.aphrody.com 8797 (Bun); deployed as a unit by publish-downloads.ts
units.shenron-container-backup.timer: docker exec pg_dump / redis BGSAVE / SQLite of the containers
units.nginx.service redis-server.service: kept masked (/dev/null) as a guard: a reinstalled host nginx or redis cannot take 80/443/6379 from the containers
